column1: #   Bash rows       column 3 is the command ("\n" means a real newline)
#   Edit/Write rows column 3 is a single arg, e.g. file_path=/some/path
# <expected> is what must decide the call:
#   auto_defer        escalates with default_action=defer (human must act)
#   escalate_default  no rule matched; the human is asked, default approve
#   deny_silent       bash_composition refused it WITHOUT asking a human
# Every row below is a behaviour someone paid for. Do not relax an expectation to
# make this pass — if a row flips, either the policy regressed or the reason it
# was pinned no longer holds, and that has to be argued in the commit message.
# --- D3: output suppression is not a device write --------------------------
# The whole reason this file was rewritten. `> /dev/` matched `> /dev/null` and
# escalated it as severity=high, twice in the 2026-08-05/06 dogfood.
# The unspaced forms were auto-approved before this rewrite: no shell requires a
# space after `>`, and `cat ` matches the auto_approve read-tools rule. Upstream
# still has that gap; see divergence 3 in the policy's own _comment.
# --- arbitrary code execution reaches a human -------------------------------
# The old policy had no auto_defer list at all, so `node -e '<anything>'` was
# auto-approved by `^(npm|npx|node) `. These are caught by auto_defer, which is
# evaluated BEFORE auto_approve — narrowing the approve rule alone would not do it.
# --- sudo/su reach the human even mid-command -------------------------------
# Upstream anchors these at ^ and relies on bash_composition=per_segment, which
# this policy omits; un-anchored here so the auto_approve prefixes cannot smuggle.
# Three DIFFERENT rules, and they do not share a pattern: the Bash rule uses
# `claw-drive-policy[^/]*\.json$`. Neutering one leaves the others green, so all
# Runtime state at a RELATIVE path. Upstream demands `(?:^|/)\.claw-drive/`, so
# every row here but the ./ and absolute ones was auto-approved before the fix —
# a driven session sitting in the repo root writes exactly these forms.
# ...but the guard must not fire on an unrelated path that merely ends in the name.
# --- ordinary council traffic must not be blocked ---------------------------
# `git -C` and compound `cd && npm` were escalating under the old anchored rules;
# 418 of the dogfood's 752 commands escalated, which is what made it noisy.

column3: set -e; cd /tmp/wt; cloverleaf-cli advance-status . CLV-1 implementing agent
